text:
Hannah: FYI deploybot queued an unpin for runtime-2.21 in the maintenance window (01:45 UTC). There's a client-side SDK ack behavior that might interact poorly with the new streaming kernel.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-2.21 -> prod; window=2026-04-05T01:45Z; canary=eu-west; prechecks=kv-cache,stream-smoke. Reply :approve: or :hold:.

Luis: Quick context: SDK 3.2 changed the streaming ACK latch; older clients may double-ACK and cause duplicate token emission on runtimes with the new kernel. Hosted SDK roll is staged for tomorrow.

Cory: How many API keys / customers are hitting streaming ACKs in eu-west? Can we add a header-based safe-route to keep legacy clients on runtime-2.20?

Hannah: Around 12 API keys show high-frequency streaming ACKs in eu-west. Options: delay 12h, add header/client-version exclusion, or gate the rollout to 5% with a canary bias. My preference: combine exclusion for legacy clients + ultra-small initial rollout.

deploybot: Suggested config snippet:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.headers["X-SDK-Version"] < "3.2"
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.20
    ttl: 36h
rollout_phases:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 20m
  - pct: 20
    duration: 40m
```

Luis: Also propose an automated watchdog: if duplicate_token_rate > 1.1x baseline for 10m -> pause rollout and notify sre-oncall. Add a synthetic stream test in eu-west to measure duplicates.

sre-oncall: Added alert: duplicate_token_rate > 1.1x baseline for 10m -> pause rollout and ping #eng-oncall. Synthetic monitors will post to #eng-releases-metrics.

Cory: Please include a short release note so support can triage: "Streaming: legacy SDK clients (pre-3.2) will be kept on runtime-2.20 to avoid duplicate tokens; upgrade to SDK 3.2+ when available (ticket SDK-3200)."

releasebot: Draft release note ready. Will post 30m before window to #releases with customer-facing blurb and internal KB link.

Hannah: I'll author the deploy-configs PR and run staging smoke (including synthetic duplicate stream tests).

Hannah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/921 — staging applied, synthetic stream shows zero duplicates in staging.

Luis: Marking :approve: with exclusion rule and 5% initial rollout. I'll watch metrics and be ready to pause/rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll be online for the window and will act on the pause alert if triggered. Runbook ready: infra/runbooks/pause-rollout.md

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-2.21 -> prod at 2026-04-05T01:45Z; rollout phases configured; prechecks passed.

Hannah: Copy. End of thread.
